description:
C3 2023 WINTER SUBMISSION

One of the spooky scary backgrounds seen in the Cave of Skeletons, from Castlevania: Harmony of Dissonance. It depicts the skeleton of Medusa, one of the Dracula's most loyal servants. A great fit for haunted cave levels, in general.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
